CONSTRUCTION ISSUE — subject to site survey & local engineer sign-off
Measured, level & structural survey; utility scan
Site set-up, protection, skip hire, clean
Ø110 PVC-U SN8 drain incl. bedding & surround
SD1 slot drain 100 mm, B125, incl. outlet
Yard gully 300 with silt bucket & grate
SA1 soakaway crate 1.0 m³ incl. geotextile (or connect to SW)
Pads C25/30 800x800x700 incl. rebar Ø12 @150 BW
Supply, fabricate, HDG & erect steel per schedule (S1)
M12 resin anchors to façade incl. pull tests
1.5 mm TPO membrane incl. upstands, gutter lining
Outlet O1 Ø63 + leaf guard; overflow scupper
3 mm alu fascia & capping RAL 9010, 370 high
Post cladding 20 mm thermo-ash, 160 sq, h 2.25
Render 2 coats + paint, kerb external faces
SS climbing wires 3 mm incl. eyes & tensioners
PCC edging 50x150 S edge on haunch
D01 alu glazed door 1100x2400 incl. ironmongery
D03 timber lattice door 900x2400 incl. lining
G01 lattice screen 3.0 m x 1.8 incl. gate & posts
DL1 downlights / WL1 wall light / UL1-6 spikes
Circuits, RCBOs, socket SO1, controls, testing
Plants per schedule incl. olive & pot
Quantities are net, measured from the drawings (no waste unless stated). Contractor to verify on site & price each line; state lead times for items 4, 9. Excel version: output/BOQ_Design-A.xlsx.
